title: Better Locator Bar
description: This mod backports the Locator Bar from modern Minecraft to BTA!
body:
# About:
This mod backports the locator bar that lets you see where your friends are from modern Minecraft to a heavily modified version of beta 1.7.3 called Better Than Adventure!

This mod adds an xp-like bar just above your hotbar that lets you see where your friends are indicated by a colored dot!

As you move your camera, the dot changes in the x direction to indicate where your friend is! And as you move further away from your friend, their dot gets smaller!

## Planned Features:

Not every feature of the locator bar has been added yet; this is what is planned:

- Y-level difference indicator
- The bar does not track a player outside of one's own render distance.
- More...

### Dependencies:



[HalpLibe](https://modrinth.com/mod/halplibe)
